August Strindberg, The Inferno, translated by Claud Field.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/august-strindberg/the-inferno/claud-field

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- August Strindberg, the author, died 1912 (UK for the text used (1913 English translation by the British translator Claud Field); original French text 1898).
- Claud Field, the translator, died 1941.

First publication of the text used: 1898 (SE colophon: 'The Inferno was published in 1898 by August Strindberg. It was translated from French in 1913 by Claud Field'; English Wikipedia 'Inferno (Strindberg novel)': written in French in 1896-97).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1898, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1993.
- Country of origin (UK for the text used (1913 English translation by the British translator Claud Field); original French text 1898): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1941, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 2012.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: original (French) 1898, Field translation 1913; no editor/introducer mentioned
- Wikidata Q16775654 (Claud Field, 'translator'), P570 = 1941 (refs: FAST, Trove, Project Gutenberg)
- English Wikipedia 'August Strindberg' infobox: death_date = 19 May 1912 (Wikidata EntitySearch for the name failed to return the playwright; Wikipedia used instead)
